_note: E18 credential-attacks-at-scale attack fragment (awareness). A fragment of the `social` block; the wiring agent copies people, intelFacts and osint into scenarios/awareness_e18_credential_attacks_at_scale/scenario.json.erb (01 P2), with the `_` notes stripped. The attack half is the OSINT stage (collect the practice's five public details as facts) followed by the `guess` stage in mode "spray" (ENG-02 + ENG-02b), whose config block lives in full_only.json at social.awarenessEpisode.guess (episode-level, full-only; same placement as E9's guess block). There is no mail send, no landing page, no template set and no phishTarget: the organisation-scale campaign console is the attack artefact. Nothing typed is a real password; every account, word, address and breach-list row is made up. The roster names are the built Merrin & Sallow cast (E4) plus Dani Fenwick (E14), used by name only as the harvested staff list; the opened accounts are shown as a count, never pinned on a named colleague (no-blame). Merrin & Sallow Architects and everyone named are fictional (BRAND_SET.md, merrin_sallow); every domain ends .example. E18 is the organisation-scale twin of E9 and must not repeat E9's single-person guesser.
_sources_note: Fact source ids differ from the E18 brief's suggested labels where the brief's label would not survive the awareness profile. ms_email_pattern is sourced to a block on the company Contact page (blk_contact), not a 'published PDF': the awareness profile hides document sites (osint.rb site_types), so a PDF/document source could never be opened. All five facts therefore sit on the company site's pages. merrin_social carries one flavour profile for texture (the 'harvest from public pages' theme), with no fact of its own.

ms_team_roster.text: The 'People' page lists the practice's staff by full name: Catherine Merrin, Julian Sallow, Yasmin Chaudhry, Thandiwe Moyo, Dani Fenwick and others.
ms_team_roster.subject: company
ms_team_roster.reduceNote: A public team page hands an attacker the whole staff list in one go, without needing a single password.

ms_email_pattern.text: Staff email addresses are built as firstname.lastname@merrinsallow.example.
ms_email_pattern.subject: company
ms_email_pattern.reduceNote: Once the address pattern is known, every name on the team page turns into a working address to try.

ms_projects.text: The 'Projects' page names current schemes, among them Calderbank Mills and Elmgate Pavilion.
ms_projects.subject: company
ms_projects.reduceNote: Project names on the website are exactly the kind of word people put in a password, so they go straight into the word list.

ms_motto.text: The practice's strapline is 'Design that lasts'.
ms_motto.subject: company
ms_motto.reduceNote: A strapline printed on the home page is a handful of memorable words, and memorable words become passwords.

ms_place.text: The studio is on Verrow Street.
ms_place.subject: company
ms_place.reduceNote: A street name from the 'Visit us' page is one more word off the website to add to the list.
